args.title: checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions following the latest deploy. Action taken: rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent version that was healthy in production) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Rollback verified, service health restored (healthy=true, error rate ~0.2%). Next steps: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failures before attempting a re-deploy.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the problem:** The latest production release, v2.3.1, was unhealthy. The most recent release that was healthy in production was v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it wasn't a candidate).
2. **Rolled back:** Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout was verified successfully.
3. **Confirmed recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions, with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2):** Documenting the failure of v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the recommendation to investigate the root cause before redeploying. The on-call engineer has been paged.
